items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Interviewer mentions: 'His nephew's playing with Solistan... Yeah, you know, Solistan's band is going. Oh, I know.' Interviewee responds: 'Well, where do they play?'

ctx.x: Laplace, huh? Well, he was one of Jack Carey's, you know, under-comped fellas. Jack Carey, he just liked Jack Carey, and he's played just like Jack Carey.

Well, there's somebody for us to dig that. Yeah. It's only about 20 or 30 miles up there. Huh? It's only about 20 or 30 miles up there. Yeah, yeah, that's pretty much crunchy. His nephew's playing with Solistan, and I played Daniel Albert. Yeah. He was Solistan now. Yeah, you know, Solistan's band is going. Oh, I know.
